The EPAR's surrounding prose names the programme studies CS1, CS2, CS3A, CS3B, CS4, CS10, CS11 (SHINE), CS12, SM201 (NURTURE) and SM202 (EMBRACE), and states on p.86 that "Only limited data (e.g., SAEs, deaths) from subjects participating in some blinded studies (CS4, CS11, and SM202) have been included to protect study integrity".

This row is the curated set's ADJACENT-HAEMATOLOGY FALLBACK (is_platelet_specific FALSE) and should not be read as a measured platelet negative. Independently confirmed from the primary document: the SmPC platelet warning is an explicit CLASS-EFFECT precaution, not a nusinersen finding - EPAR p.103, "Changes to the SmPC have been implemented, such as the abovementioned warning regarding class effect with other ASO and phosphorothioate linkers regarding potential effect on kidney function and platelet count/coagulation."

In the placebo group, 1 patient had a transient moderate AE of thrombocytopenia and 1 patient had a mild AE of platelet count decreased (intermittent, not recovered/resolved)." Platelet parameters were therefore explicitly measured longitudinally across the 18-month exposure, with a CTCAE threshold applied.
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 NCT01960348 (fetched 2026-10-01) -> officialTitle "APOLLO: A Phase 3 Multicenter, Multinational, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Patisiran (ALN-TTR02) in Transthyretin...", sponsor protocol ALN-TTR02-004, interventions [patisiran (ALN-TTR02), Sterile Normal Saline], phase PHASE3, enrollment 225 ACTUAL, participant-flow STARTED 148 / 77. The EPAR's 'Study 004' maps to protocol ALN-TTR02-004 = NCT01960348; the curated FDA row TMSR1710 independently labels the same trial "APOLLO / study ALN-TTR02-004".
studies.notes: DEDUPLICATION: three rows from TWO regulators collapse to this ONE trial - TMSR1709 (EMA Onpattro EPAR p.163 haematology narrative), TMSR1710 (FDA NDA 210922 clinical review section 8.4.6 'Platelets' narrative) and TMSR1716 (FDA Table 68 mean minimum change from baseline, -11 x10^9/L on patisiran vs -23 on placebo). They are not three studies. CROSS-DOCUMENT DISCREPANCY TO RESOLVE: TMSR1710 records "lowest observed value 72 x10^9/L in a subject whose baseline was already 73 x10^9/L" without naming the arm, while the EPAR states at p.164 "There was 1 patient in the 004 placebo group who had a single platelet count <75 x 109/L (Grade 2)." If the 72 x10^9/L value is that subject, it is a PLACEBO subject and the row's attribution to the patisiran exposure is misleading; the two statements cannot both describe a patisiran-arm subject, since a patisiran subject at 72 would be a second <75 value. Recommend re-reading the FDA review narrative to fix the arm attribution. The direction of effect is the scientifically load-bearing point: the mean nadir excursion was SMALLER on drug than on placebo (-11 vs -23 x10^9/L).

studies.notes: DEDUPLICATION, and the one cross-compound subtlety in this cluster: TMSR1717 measures PATISIRAN (oligo_id TOLG247) but it was measured in the patisiran REFERENCE ARM OF HELIOS-A, not in APOLLO. It therefore belongs to this trial, not to patisiran-APOLLO - treating it as a separate patisiran study would double-count both the trial and the patisiran platelet evidence. TMSR1958 (EMA) and TMSR1959 (FDA Table 24) are the same trial assessed by two regulators and are likewise one trial, not two. The patisiran reference arm here is a genuine independent replication of the APOLLO platelet-neutrality finding in a different trial and analysed by a different agency.

The same page records why platelets were examined at all: "Because thrombocytopenia, coagulation abnormalities, and renal toxicity have been observed with other subcutaneously or intravenously administered ASOs, the applicant reviewed all AEs reported in the clinical program to identify any relevant AEs for the original submission." Platelet counts were therefore followed over time within a randomised, placebo-controlled 28-week window.
studies.verification_locus: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 NCT02623699 (fetched 2026-10-01) -> sponsor protocol 233AS101, acronym field reads "VALOR (Part C)", officialTitle "A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics, and Pharmacodynamics of BIIB067 Administered to Adult Subjects With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis...", interventions [Tofersen, Placebo], enrollment 176 ACTUAL, arm labels include 'Part A-SAD', 'Part B-MAD' and 'Part C-Pivotal: Tofersen 100 mg' / 'Part C-Pivotal: Placebo'. Placebo Pool RC2 (N=36)".
studies.notes: Resolves the naming ambiguity that could easily have produced two phantom trials: VALOR is NOT a separate registration - the ClinicalTrials.gov record for study 101 (233AS101) carries the acronym "VALOR (Part C)", so 'study 101 Part C' and 'VALOR' are the same registered trial. The curated row's second clause ('no AEs of thrombocytopenia and no sustained or severe thrombocytopenia in the whole clinical development programme') is PROGRAMME-level, not trial-level - verbatim at the same locus: "In the CDP, no AEs of thrombocytopenia or any cases of sustained or severe thrombocytopenia were identified in tofersen-treated participants". Only the Part C platelet-count comparison is attributable to this trial. Scientifically the most informative negative control in this cluster: a 2'-MOE gapmer with a phosphorothioate backbone that produces no platelet signal when given intrathecally.

DEFECT in the source row: TMSR1766's effect_vs_control reads "6 participants (4.1%) had a shift to a low platelet count; proportion similar to placebo", which welds together two different sentences about two different populations. notes: CLUSTER other_regulatory: 19 curated measurement rows across 6 approved oligonucleotides resolve to 18 evidence units - 12 individually registered human trials (every one with an NCT id verified live against the ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API on 2026-10-01) and 6 pooled/integrated analyses that are NOT trials. ROW-TO-TRIAL RATIO: the 19 rows contain only 8 row-bearing trials; 4 of the 12 trials are constituent-only records carrying zero measurement_ids (nusinersen-CS3B-ENDEAR, olezarsen-CS5-sHTG, olezarsen-CS6-sHTG, tofersen-233AS102-OLE), created solely because each is named - with its registry id - at the very locus the measurement was taken from. No constituent record was invented: where a pooled locus did not enumerate its constituents (nusinersen-EPAR-integrated-safety-pool) constituents_identifiable is set to 'partial' and no constituent records were created. DEDUPLICATION PERFORMED: (a) patisiran APOLLO is ONE trial carrying three rows from two regulators - EMA Onpattro EPAR p.163 (TMSR1709) plus two FDA NDA 210922 loci (TMSR1710, TMSR1716); (b) HELIOS-A is ONE trial carrying three rows - the EMA Amvuttra EPAR p.127 vutrisiran statement (TMSR1958), the FDA Table 24 vutrisiran shift row (TMSR1959) and, critically, the FDA Table 24 PATISIRAN row (TMSR1717), which measures patisiran but inside the HELIOS-A reference arm and so is not a second patisiran study; (c) 'VALOR' and 'study 101 Part C' are the same registration (NCT02623699 carries the acronym 'VALOR (Part C)'), which would otherwise have produced a phantom extra tofersen trial. ONLY ONE SEVERE SIGNAL IN THE WHOLE CLUSTER: TMSR1546, nusinersen Study 2 = CHERISH (NCT02292537), two patients below 50,000/uL with a nadir of 10,000/uL on study day 28 - and it occurs by the INTRATHECAL route. Everything else is grade 0-1 and, where a comparator exists, at or below the control rate (inclisiran 1/1833 vs 1/1822 placebo across ORION-9/10/11; patisiran mean nadir -11 vs -23 x10^9/L on placebo; vutrisiran no clinically significant platelet abnormality in any subject; tofersen shifts similar to placebo). NO FABRICATED NEGATIVES: platelet_endpoint_evaluable is 'yes' only where the primary text shows the platelet endpoint was actually assessed under a defined exposure and observation window (pre-specified hematology schedules and CTCAE/potentially-clinically-significant thresholds for inclisiran; label-mandated platelet counts at baseline and before each dose for nusinersen; longitudinal platelet parameters with a CTCAE Grade 3 threshold for patisiran; FDA-generated post-baseline shift tables for vutrisiran; platelet counts over time in a randomised placebo-controlled window for tofersen). It is 'partial' for the three constituent-only trials with no trial-specific platelet figure, and 'partial' for nusinersen-EPAR-integrated-safety-pool, whose locus reports haematology only at panel level and does not itemise platelets - that row is the curated set's declared adjacent-haematology fallback and must not be read as a measured platelet negative. FOUR DEFECTS FOUND IN THE UNDERLYING ROWS, each confirmed against a primary document: (1) TMSR1708 (olezarsen) records dose 80 mg, but the 12% (5/43) figure is the TRYNGOLZA label's 'Total TRYNGOLZA (N=43)' column, i.e. the 50 mg (N=21) and 80 mg (N=22) arms POOLED - it is not an 80 mg incidence and must not be used as the high-dose point of a dose-response series. (2) TMSR1766 (tofersen) appends 'proportion similar to placebo' to the Pool ABCL1 4.1% figure, but Pool ABCL1 is a single-arm all-tofersen pool (N=147) with no placebo group; the 'similar to placebo' sentence belongs to study 101 Part C only. Its denominator is also 147, not 146 (6/147 = 4.08%). (3) TMSR1765 (tofersen) says the 2 participants below 100 x10^9/L arose 'across studies 101 and 102', but the EPAR localises both to study 101 (one in Part B, one in Part C); study 102 contributed no event. (4) TMSR1546 (nusinersen) records exposure_duration '28d', but day 28 is when the platelet nadir was recorded - CHERISH ran 15 months. ONE CROSS-DOCUMENT DISCREPANCY FLAGGED FOR RE-READING, not resolved here: TMSR1710 reports APOLLO's 'lowest observed value 72 x10^9/L in a subject whose baseline was already 73 x10^9/L' without naming the arm, while Onpattro EPAR p.164 states that the single <75 x10^9/L value in study 004 was in the PLACEBO group. Both cannot describe a patisiran-arm subject. OVERLAPPING DENOMINATORS - DO NOT SUM: olezarsen-label-sHTG-pool (Trials 2+3) is nested inside olezarsen-label-all-trials-pool (Trials 1+2+3); tofersen-pool-ABCL1 (28 Feb 2023 cut) and tofersen-101-102-15Jul2022-analysis cover the same two registrations at different data cuts; the nusinersen label section 5.1 pool and the Spinraza EPAR integrated pool both draw on ENDEAR and CHERISH. registry_id convention: 'NOT_APPLICABLE_POOLED' marks the 6 pooled analyses, which are not registrable entities. No value anywhere in this file is 'NOT_REGISTERED': every trial unit in this cluster is a modern registered trial (earliest start 2013-11, APOLLO), so there was no occasion to assert non-registration. No study_key, registry id, enrollment number, date or quoted sentence in this file was guessed - every quote was read out of the document named in its verification_locus, except where a note states explicitly that the quote is carried from the curated row because the document was unreachable.
